notes: A squat could be misread as a drill: the classifier counted every up-and-down change in your hip height, so one pose misread invented two of them — one into the glitch, one back out — and a squat that already had two real direction changes crossed the line into ‘drill’, so the squat counter never ran and the rep was lost. Direction changes are now counted on a smoothed hip-height line (a 3-point median), so a lone bad frame can’t invent one. A real A-skip bounce still reads as a drill, on uploads and on the live camera.
